in_hindi.name: माँगू
in_hindi.long_meaning: Father who is free from bondage

in_marathi.name: Mangu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mangu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amang', meaning 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, 'Mangal' is the name of the planet Mars and 'Ang' refers to the Moon. Thus, 'Mangu' is a reverential name for the Moon God.

in_bengali.name: Mangu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mangu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amang', meaning 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, 'Mangal' is the name of the planet Mars and 'Ang' refers to the Moon. Thus, 'Mangu' is a reverential name for the Moon God.
